errors.evidence: This description of the 'EU-27' line is incorrect. The line's highest point is at the end (X=20, value ≈ 12.8), not at X=17 (value ≈ 11.5). Consequently, the claim that the line decreases after X=17 is false; it actually continues to increase until X=20. The final value is also misreported as 11.8 instead of ≈12.8.
